title: Untwisting the double copy: the zeroth copy as an optical seed
summary: We present a historical optical foundation for stationary vacuum Kerr--Schild spacetimes on a flat background and interpret it in modern double-copy language. In this setting, a complex optical seed \(ρ=-θ-iω\), built from the expansion and signed twist of the Kerr--Schild congruence, is harmonic, while its inverse obeys an eikonal equation and reconstructs the congruence algebraically. Thus the local stationary geometry is organized by a single complex seed.
